game_concept: A survival strategy set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse, the frozen gate of the hold: the hold guard must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Countdown Recursion: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Gatehouse: the frozen gate of the hold
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Gatehouse, repeat each round: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case. Each round, frost imps strike the frozen well, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the base_case value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the frozen well from frost imps in Frozen Gatehouse: keep the base_case meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 45-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: base_case drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 45-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Countdown Recursion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Countdown Recursion' (Week 6 slot 11), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Frozen Gatehouse'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how base_case changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Frozen Gatehouse.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 45 seconds while base_case > 0.
